Food and service quality are average
Oct 2026 • Couples
Before coming, I saw it was recommended by Michelin, and the ratings on Google and Trip Advisor were very high. The restaurant is in an excellent downtown location, and the interior and exterior decor are very thoughtful. Sitting outside allows you to watch the bustling street view, but it was much worse than expected:
1. The waitstaff's efficiency is extremely low; many staff members present seem to be slacking off, lacking systematic training, and they don't respond promptly even when we wave to them.
2. It can actually serve 5 dishes in 5 minutes, which is fast but too rough, and the taste is mediocre.
3. The tableware and bowls have 3-4 pieces with chips, which is really not up to standard.

At that point, I decided to look more carefully inside the restaurant area upstairs where I had originally been seated. Eventually, I discovered the umbrella was hidden behind the counter on the second floor. They can’t deny anymore.

After retrieving it, I was able to confirm that it had been kept on the premises all along. I was surprised that it had not been returned earlier despite the prior confirmation.

Don’t waste your money and time here.
